article.story: No. 24 Memphis (8-2) at Navy (3-6), Nov. 21 at 12 p.m. EST. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Navy Offense Overall: 414 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 116.3 yards per game (135th) Rushing: 297.7 yards per game (3rd) Scoring: 29.2 points per game (58th) Navy Defense Overall: 355.6 yards per game (66th in FBS) Passing: 242.9 yards per game (117th) Rushing: 112.7 yards per game (27th) Scoring: 30.4 points per game (114th) Memphis Offense Overall: 520.7 yards per game (2nd in FBS) Passing: 292.8 yards per game (12th) Rushing: 227.9 yards per game (8th) Scoring: 39 points per game (8th) Memphis Defense Overall: 393.9 yards per game (107th in FBS) Passing: 197.3 yards per game (48th) Rushing: 196.6 yards per game (126th) Scoring: 25.3 points per game (73rd) Navy ranks 65th in third down percentage, converting 40.2% of the time. Memphis ranks 10th on defense, allowing its opponents to convert at 30.9%. Navy ranks 116th in the FBS with a -6 turnover margin, compared to Memphis' 26th-ranked +5 margin. Memphis is 25th in the FBS averaging 44.7 penalty yards per game. Memphis is 8th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 72.2% of trips. Memphis ranks 113th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:18, compared to Navy's 7th-ranked average of 33:07. Team leaders Navy Passing: Jackson Gutierrez, 895 yards, 8 TDs, 2 INTs, 51.9 completion percentage Rushing: Gutierrez, 1,158 yards on 208 carries, 18 TDs Receiving: Jordan Collins, 324 yards on 8 catches, 4 TDs Memphis Passing: Marcus Stokes, 2,845 yards, 28 TDs, 6 INTs, 66.9 completion percentage Rushing: Jaylin Carter, 1,038 yards on 172 carries, 12 TDs Receiving: Jemyri Davis, 561 yards on 28 catches, 7 TDs Last game Navy won 42-35 over Temple on Nov. 7. Gutierrez led Navy with 178 yards on 6-of-11 passing (54.5%) for one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball 30 times for 180 yards and five rushing touchdowns. Michael Barrow had 109 rushing yards on 21 carries, adding three receptions for 42 yards. Collins put up 112 yards on two catches with one touchdown. Memphis beat South Florida 52-41 on Nov. 12. Stokes led Memphis with 313 yards on 15-of-31 passing (48.4%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball eight times for 73 yards and two rushing touchdowns. Carter had 109 rushing yards on 21 carries and two touchdowns. Davis had five receptions for 161 yards and one touchdown. Next game Navy plays at Charlotte on Nov. 28. Memphis hosts Temple on Nov. 27.
